name: 闪念盒
description: flomo 式低摩擦速记:文字或语音随手记一条,自动按月落成你笔记库里的纯 Markdown 文件(<工作文件夹>/YYYY-MM.md,# 标签行内直打),时间线 / 标签过滤 / 12 周热力图一目了然;每天从 7 天前更早的旧闪念里抽几条「每日回顾」再浮现,单条可一键转正式笔记;「AI 周整理」把近期闪念文本交给你自己的 Tangu 引擎按主题聚类成周报,产物写回 整理/ 文件夹。数据流向:闪念全部存在本地笔记库,语音走 Forsion 桌面自带的语音识别链路(不保存音频原文件),AI 周整理只把闪念文本发给你登录的 Forsion 后端,不经任何第三方服务。
descriptionEn: Low-friction capture, flomo style: jot a thought by typing or by voice and it lands as plain Markdown in your own vault, one file per month (<work folder>/YYYY-MM.md, with # tags written inline). A timeline, tag filters and a 12-week heatmap keep it all in view. Every day a few older memos (7+ days back) resurface as Daily Review cards, and any single memo can be turned into a real note in one click. AI Weekly Digest hands your recent memos to your own Tangu engine, which clusters them by theme into a weekly write-up saved back into the 整理/ folder. Where the data goes: memos never leave your local vault; voice goes through Forsion Desktop's own speech pipeline (no audio file is kept); AI Weekly Digest sends memo text only to the Forsion backend you are signed in to, never to a third party.

onboarding.intro: 闪念盒 = 想到就记、记了会再见到:速记进月文件,每天回顾几条旧想法,攒够一周让 Tangu 帮你按主题整理。

steps.title: 随手记
steps.description: 命令面板「闪念盒:打开」进视图,输入框 Enter 发送、Shift+Enter 换行,# 打标签(如 #产品)。不想开视图就点状态栏「✎ 闪念」或命令「闪念盒:快速记一条」,一行输入直接落库。

steps.title: 语音速记
steps.description: 输入区的 🎙 按钮:按住说话松开结束,或点一下开始、再点一下结束。转写走 Forsion 桌面自己的语音链路(设置 → 语音),文字先进输入框给你改,不会直接发出;插件不保存音频原文件。

steps.title: 每日回顾
steps.description: 当天存在 7 天前更早的未归档闪念时,输入区下方会浮出几张回顾卡(条数在插件设置里改),逐张选「跳过 / 转笔记 / 归档」,全部处理完自动收起。同一天里抽到的卡固定,第二天换一批。

steps.title: 找回来
steps.description: 时间线倒序按日分组;点正文里的 #标签 过滤,搜索框全文过滤,热力图(近 12 周)点格子看那天记了什么。单条可就地编辑、置顶、归档、删除。

steps.title: AI 周整理
steps.description: 命令「闪念盒:AI 周整理」:把近 7 天(不足 50 条则取最近 50 条)的闪念交给 Tangu 按主题聚类,产出存到 整理/YYYY-Www-周整理.md 并自动打开。需要已登录 Forsion。

steps.title: 数据在哪
steps.description: 全部在你的笔记库:月文件 <工作文件夹>/YYYY-MM.md(纯 Markdown,可直接当笔记打开),派生统计 .memoflow-cache.json(可随时点「重建缓存」按钮从月文件重算),转笔记与周整理产物在 整理/ 子文件夹。产物路径固定,不随界面语言变。

en.intro: MemoFlow = capture the thought, then meet it again: memos land in a monthly file, a few older ones resurface every day, and once a week Tangu clusters them by theme for you.

steps.title: Capture
steps.description: Open the view with the "MemoFlow: Open" command. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line, # writes a tag inline (e.g. #product). Don't want the view? Click "✎ Memo" in the status bar or run "MemoFlow: Quick Capture" — one line of input goes straight into the vault.

steps.title: Voice capture
steps.description: The 🎙 button in the composer: hold to talk and release to finish, or click once to start and again to stop. Transcription runs through Forsion Desktop's own speech pipeline (Settings → Voice). The text lands in the composer first so you can fix it — nothing is sent automatically, and no audio file is kept.

steps.title: Daily Review
steps.description: On days when you have unarchived memos from 7+ days ago, a few review cards appear under the composer (count is a plugin setting). Handle each one with Skip / To Note / Archive; the strip folds away once they are all done. The picks stay fixed for the day and change tomorrow.

steps.title: Find it again
steps.description: The timeline runs newest-first, grouped by day. Click a #tag in a memo to filter, use the search box for full-text filtering, and click a heatmap cell (last 12 weeks) to see what you wrote that day. Each memo can be edited in place, pinned, archived or deleted.

steps.title: AI Weekly Digest
steps.description: Run "MemoFlow: AI Weekly Digest": the last 7 days of memos (or the most recent 50 if that is fewer) go to Tangu, which clusters them by theme. The result is saved to 整理/YYYY-Www-周整理.md and opened for you. Requires being signed in to Forsion.

steps.title: Where the data lives
steps.description: All of it is in your vault: monthly files at <work folder>/YYYY-MM.md (plain Markdown, openable as ordinary notes), derived stats in .memoflow-cache.json (the "Rebuild Cache" button recomputes them from the monthly files at any time), and notes plus digests in the 整理/ subfolder. Those paths are fixed — they do not change with the interface language.
